entries.name: Equity
entries.description: Reserve of the Frankencoin system and its governance token (FPS): holds all ZCHF reserves and absorbs losses before ZCHF holders do. FPS is minted and redeemed permissionlessly against ZCHF at a formula price (3x underlying equity, 90-day minimum holding before redemption). Votes equal FPS balance times holding time; 2% of total votes qualifies an address (with delegates) for all veto and proposal rights in the system. There is no admin.

receivedPermissions.description: propose changes to the ZCHF CCIP token pool configuration (add/remove chains and remote pools; 7-day delay) or a transfer of the CCIP admin role and pool ownership (21-day delay), with 2% of FPS votes.
immediately set per-chain CCIP rate limits for bridged ZCHF and veto pending CCIPAdmin proposals, with 2% of FPS votes.

propose a new interest rate for the Savings module with 2% of FPS votes, in force after 7 days unless replaced by a counter-proposal. The rate is paid to savers (including the SavingsVault) by minting against the equity reserve.
propose a new leadrate with 2% of FPS votes, in force after 7 days unless replaced by a counter-proposal. This sets the rate that all MintingHubV2 positions pay and SavingsV2 depositors earn.
halve the accrued holding duration of the FPSWrapper with 2% of FPS votes, delaying WFPS holders' ability to redeem the underlying FPS for ZCHF.
veto pending minter applications with 2% of FPS votes. This is the system's main safeguard: an unvetoed minter is irrevocable and can mint unlimited ZCHF.

entries.name: CCIPAdmin
entries.description: Owner and admin of the ZCHF CCIP token pool and of the ZCHF entry in Chainlink's TokenAdminRegistry. Every action requires 2% of FPS votes: pool configuration changes (adding/removing chains and remote pools) execute after a 7-day timelock, handover of the admin role after 21 days; setting rate limits and vetoing pending proposals is immediate.

receivedPermissions.description: configure remote chains, pool addresses, router, allowlist, admins, and rebalancer for this token pool.

pendingProposals.description: Hashes of timelocked CCIPAdmin proposals that are currently pending (proposed but not yet enacted or denied). A new entry starts the 7-day (config) or 21-day (admin transfer) veto window.

proposedAdminTransfers.description: All addresses ever proposed as new CCIP admin (21-day timelock). A transfer hands over ownership of the ZCHF token pool and its TokenAdminRegistry entry.

rateLimitUpdates.description: History of per-chain CCIP rate limit changes (chain selectors, from RateLimit events). Rate limits bound how much ZCHF a CCIP compromise could mint and are changeable immediately by qualified FPS holders.

entries.name: Savings
entries.description: Current savings module: deposited ZCHF earns a governance-set interest rate, minted against the equity reserve (3-day interest delay on deposits). Savers can opt into a referral fee of up to 25% of their interest for frontends. Rate changes are proposed by qualified FPS holders and take effect after 7 days unless replaced by a counter-proposal.

receivedPermissions.description: mint and burn ZCHF without restriction, transfer ZCHF from any account (minters have unlimited allowance), and book profits and losses against the reserve held in the Equity contract.

entries.name: StablecoinBridgeVCHF
entries.description: Mints ZCHF against a whitelisted Swiss franc stablecoin held in escrow, at a fixed 1:1 (decimal-adjusted) rate, up to a hard cap and only until its expiration (see isExpired). An expired bridge is permanently mint-disabled, but ZCHF from it can always be burned to redeem the escrowed stablecoin. A depeg or freeze of the escrowed stablecoin impairs ZCHF backing up to the cap.

receivedPermissions.description: mint and burn ZCHF without restriction, transfer ZCHF from any account (minters have unlimited allowance), and book profits and losses against the reserve held in the Equity contract.

limit.description: Maximum ZCHF that can ever be minted through this bridge.

horizon.description: Timestamp after which the bridge can no longer mint (one year from deployment).

minted.description: ZCHF currently outstanding from this bridge.

isExpired.description: True once the minting horizon has passed: the bridge is deprecated and can only redeem ZCHF for the escrowed stablecoin, never mint again.

entries.name: SavingsV2
entries.description: Original savings module, superseded as a savings product by the current Savings module but still the system's authoritative leadrate source: MintingHubV2 positions pay this contract's rate plus their risk premium (remaining depositors earn it, minted against the equity reserve and capped by it). Rate changes are proposed by qualified FPS holders and take effect after 7 days unless replaced by a counter-proposal.

entries.name: LeadrateSender
entries.description: Permissionless helper that pushes the Savings module's current interest rate to bridged savings modules on other chains via CCIP; anyone can trigger a push by paying the CCIP fee.

entries.name: FPSWrapper
entries.description: Wrapper token (WFPS) for FPS. Wrapped shares cannot vote individually and can be unwrapped or redeemed for ZCHF at any time, subject to the wrapper's collective holding duration.

entries.name: MintingHubV1
entries.description: Deprecated first version of the minting hub with the same oracle-free, auction-policed design (fixed upfront fees instead of the leadrate-linked interest of V2). The official frontend no longer supports it, but it remains a registered minter forever and stays permissionlessly usable.

openedPositions.description: All positions ever opened through this deprecated hub, from PositionOpened events. A new entry is unexpected and warrants review: new originals still pass a 3+ day veto window, but the hub is no longer curated by the Frankencoin frontend.

entries.description: Helper that rolls debt and collateral from one minting position into another in a single transaction. It is a registered minter but uses that right only transiently within a roll.

entries.name: Frankencoin
entries.description: The ZCHF stablecoin token. Immutable and ownerless: supply is controlled exclusively by registered 'minter' modules. Anyone can apply to add a minter by paying a fee of at least 1,000 ZCHF; it becomes active unless vetoed by FPS holders with 2% of votes during the application period (at least 14 days). Once active, a minter is irrevocable.

MIN_APPLICATION_PERIOD.description: Minimum veto period (in seconds) for new minter applications.

minters.description: All registered (or, if recently suggested, pending) minter modules, reconstructed from MinterApplied/MinterDenied events.

reserve.description: The Equity contract holding the ZCHF reserve.

entries.name: MintingHubV2
entries.description: Permissionless factory for collateralized ZCHF minting positions: anyone can open a position with any ERC20 collateral and a self-declared liquidation price for a 1,000 ZCHF fee, or clone an approved one for free. No price oracle is used; anyone can challenge an overpriced position in a collateral auction (2% challenger reward) and qualified FPS holders (2% of votes) can veto new positions during their initialization period. Positions prepay interest (leadrate plus a fixed risk premium) at minting for the term to expiration and are individually registered as minters (not listed here).

receivedPermissions.description: mint and burn ZCHF without restriction, transfer ZCHF from any account (minters have unlimited allowance), and book profits and losses against the reserve held in the Equity contract.

rate.description: The contract providing the leadrate, the base interest rate positions pay on minted ZCHF.

entries.name: SavingsVault
entries.description: ERC4626 vault (svZCHF) over the Savings module: deposited ZCHF is forwarded there and interest auto-compounds into the share price. Ownership has been renounced, so its only privileged function (activating a referral-fee skim of up to 25% of interest) is permanently disabled and the vault is fully immutable.

entries.name: TransferReference
entries.description: Convenience contract for ZCHF transfers with an attached payment reference, on Ethereum and cross-chain via CCIP. It is registered as a minter solely for the resulting unlimited allowance; its code only moves funds of the caller or of accounts that granted the caller an explicit infinite allowance.

entries.name: GovernanceSender
entries.description: Permissionless helper that pushes FPS voting-power snapshots to bridged governance contracts on other chains via CCIP; anyone can trigger a sync by paying the CCIP fee.
